title: I'm building a Path of Building inspired game. Having no experience in coding (apart from Matlab), surprised how far I got in a weekend!
author: KungFusion
selftext:
Overflow is a placeholder name, but for those of you not familiar with Path of Exile (PoE), there's a tool called Path of Building that lets you test PoE builds by simulating the calculations and math behind a PoE build. 

I thought, why not make a game based on a tool that simulates one of my favourite games. 

I've already mocked up what the end-game would look like, so this is a very tiny slice of how combat would work.

https://i.redd.it/sesz5q9uz9zh1.png

Feel free to try it out at [https://kungfusionuk.itch.io/overflow](https://kungfusionuk.itch.io/overflow) pass=overflow. 

I would love any feedback on how it feels, or where it's not intuitive (pencil icon at the top).

Honestly, it's a bit scary how much I could get done (with very very limited coding experience), even just doing a little bit on the commute to work today.
